sources.title: bharat-tiny-llm · PyPI
sources.snippet: bharat-tiny-llm is the official Python package for Bharat-Tiny-LLM v2: a 1.5B-parameter LLM fine-tuned for Hinglish and Devanagari Hindi, with 33.8% token compression achieved via Brahmi script injection — 300 Devanagari subwords injected into Qwen2.5's tokenizer. Built by eulogik — an India-first AI lab shipping edge AI.
